scripts.name: Wi-Fi scan
scripts.description: List nearby access points, signal and security.

scripts.name: Wi-Fi link
scripts.description: Show the current connection, channel and address.

scripts.name: Targets
scripts.description: Scan and save the access point list, then pick a target.

scripts.name: Target -
scripts.description: Select the previous access point.

scripts.name: Target +
scripts.description: Select the next access point.

scripts.name: Access point
scripts.description: Show details of the selected access point.

scripts.name: Monitor on
scripts.description: Enable monitor mode on the external adapter (auto-detected).

scripts.name: Monitor off
scripts.description: Return the monitor interface to managed mode.

scripts.name: Deauth
scripts.description: Send deauth frames to the target. Authorised testing only.

scripts.name: Capture air
scripts.description: Record access points and clients for 18 seconds.

scripts.name: Handshake
scripts.description: Watch the target for 35s and report a captured handshake.

scripts.name: Crack handshake
scripts.description: Crack the newest capture with rockyou. Slow on this CPU.

scripts.name: WPS scan
scripts.description: List WPS-enabled access points. Needs monitor mode.

scripts.name: WPS attack
scripts.description: Bounded reaver run on the target. Authorised testing only.

scripts.name: Randomize MAC
scripts.description: Randomize the external adapter's MAC address.

scripts.name: Pixie dust
scripts.description: Offline WPS bypass on the target. Authorised testing only.

scripts.name: Handshake hunt
scripts.description: Deauth and capture in a loop until a handshake lands. Authorised testing only.

scripts.name: Rogue AP
scripts.description: Twin the target with a captive portal. Authorised testing only.

scripts.name: Bluetooth scan
scripts.description: Discover nearby Bluetooth and BLE devices.

scripts.name: Classic inquiry
scripts.description: Find discoverable classic Bluetooth devices.

scripts.name: Adapter info
scripts.description: Show the local Bluetooth controller details.

scripts.name: HCI monitor
scripts.description: Capture 8 seconds of Bluetooth controller traffic.

scripts.name: Devices
scripts.description: List paired and known Bluetooth devices.

scripts.name: GATT reader
scripts.description: Discover a BLE device and read its services.

scripts.name: BT ping
scripts.description: Ping a discovered Bluetooth device (l2ping).

scripts.name: SDP browse
scripts.description: Browse services of a discovered Bluetooth device.

scripts.name: Gateway pulse
scripts.description: Send four pings to your default gateway.

scripts.name: DNS check
scripts.description: Resolve example.com using the system resolver.

scripts.name: Interfaces
scripts.description: List interfaces and their IPv4 addresses.

scripts.name: LAN sweep
scripts.description: ARP-scan the local network for live hosts.

scripts.name: Port scan
scripts.description: SYN-scan the top 100 ports on the gateway.

scripts.name: Packet sniff
scripts.description: Capture 15s of traffic on wlan0 to a pcap file.

scripts.name: Saved captures
scripts.description: List the capture files saved on the device.

scripts.name: Capture summary
scripts.description: Summarise the most recent capture file.

scripts.name: Analyse capture
scripts.description: Protocol and conversation breakdown of the newest capture.

scripts.name: Responder
scripts.description: Poison LLMNR/NBT-NS/mDNS for 2 minutes. Authorised testing only.

scripts.name: Sockets & routes
scripts.description: Listening and established sockets, routes, ARP cache.

scripts.name: Deep scan
scripts.description: All ports with service detection on the gateway.

scripts.name: HTTP watch
scripts.description: Watch 15 seconds of HTTP request lines on the uplink.

scripts.name: Stream follow
scripts.description: Reassemble the first TCP stream in the newest capture.

scripts.name: Tailscale status
scripts.description: Read the current Tailscale connection state.

scripts.name: Vital signs
scripts.description: Read temperature, uptime, memory and storage.

scripts.name: Processes
scripts.description: Show the processes using the most CPU.

scripts.name: Storage
scripts.description: Show disk usage for the mounted filesystems.

scripts.name: USB devices
scripts.description: List USB devices (confirms the Alfa adapter).

scripts.name: Radios
scripts.description: Show radio kill switches.

scripts.name: App log
scripts.description: Show recent Nightshade log lines.

scripts.name: Update check
scripts.description: Compare the installed revision with GitHub.

scripts.name: OTA update
scripts.description: Pull the latest Nightshade from GitHub and reinstall.

scripts.name: Reboot
scripts.description: Restart the handheld now.

scripts.name: Shut down
scripts.description: Power the handheld off.
